title: Constructing custom-made radiotranscriptomic signatures of vascular inflammation from routine CT angiograms: a prospective outcomes validation study in COVID-19.
summary: An XGBoost radiotranscriptomic signature is derived from CT angiography and linked vascular transcriptomic samples, then validated for COVID-19 mortality across several prospective patient cohorts. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: Independent patient cohorts, varying CT protocols, and mortality outcomes provide validation; retrospective pandemic setting and subgroup/treatment confounding limit causal interpretation.
